allocations.requirement_text: The subtopology shall provide **command dispatching functionality** to route incoming commands to components.
The subtopology shall provide **event management functionality** to collect events.
The subtopology shall provide **health monitoring functionality** including for active components.
The subtopology shall provide **version and configuration reporting functionality** at system startup.
The subtopology shall provide **text logging functionality** for console logged event messages.
The subtopology shall provide **assert to fatal handling functionality** to convert `FW_ASSERT`s into `FATAL` events.
The subtopology shall provide **fatal-event routing functionality** to forward fatal announcements to a configurable handler.
The subtopology shall provide **telemetry sending functionality** through a configurable telemetry interface.
The subtopology shall support **configurable instance properties** for IDs, queue sizes, stack sizes, priorities, and CPU affinities.
The subtopology shall expose rate-group connection points for any rate-drive components it contains.
Support **configurable instance properties** (IDs, queue sizes, stack sizes, priorities, CPU affinities, aggregation size, packet spanning) via `ComCcsdsConfig`.
Provide **composable layer topologies**: a Space Packet packet layer (`SpacePacketFraming`, `SpacePacket`) and a TM/TC transfer frame layer (`TmTcFraming`), from which the full stack is composed.
Provide **composable layer topologies**: a Space Packet packet layer (`SpacePacketFraming`, `SpacePacket`) and a TM/TC transfer frame layer (`TmTcFraming`), from which the full stack is composed.
Provide **composable layer topologies**: a Space Packet packet layer (`SpacePacketFraming`, `SpacePacket`) and a TM/TC transfer frame layer (`TmTcFraming`), from which the full stack is composed.
Provide an F´ **framer** to convert COM buffers into framed packets for downlink using the F Prime format.
Provide an F´ **deframer** to parse incoming packets into com buffers for uplink.
Provide an F´ **router** to route deframed packets (e.g., commands/files) into the flight software.
Provide a **subtopology variant that supplies `Svc::ComStub`** designed to connect to a ByteStream driver.
Provide a **subtopology variant that expects an external `Svc::ComInterface`** supplied by the deployment.
Support **configurable instance properties** (IDs, queue sizes, stack sizes, priorities, CPU affinities) via `ComFprimeConfig`.
The subtopology shall provide data product buffer management for client components requesting product buffers.
The subtopology shall provide **data product writing functionality** to store filled products on the filesystem.
The subtopology shall provide **data product cataloging functionality** for prioritized downlink of stored products.
The subtopology shall provide **buffer accumulation** between product management and product writing.
The subtopology shall support **configurable instance properties** (IDs, queue sizes, stack sizes, priorities).
The subtopology shall expose **rate-group connection points** for components requiring scheduling.
The subtopology shall provide **data product compression processing** for product buffers.
The subtopology shall provide **ZLib-based compression** of product data.
The subtopology shall provide **buffer management** for compression working and output buffers.
The subtopology shall support **configurable buffer store properties** (sizes, counts, allocator ID).
The subtopology shall expose a **rate-group connection point** for buffer manager telemetry.
The subtopology shall provide **CFDP file transfer functionality** for reliable bidirectional file delivery.
The subtopology shall provide **on-board file management functionality** (e.g., list, remove, hash, mkdir).
The subtopology shall provide **parameter management** via the filesystem.
The subtopology shall support **configurable instance properties** (IDs, queue sizes, stack sizes, priorities, CPU affinities).
The subtopology shall expose **rate-group connection points** for the CFDP manager component.
The subtopology shall provide **file uplink functionality** to receive and reconstruct files from ground.
The subtopology shall provide **file downlink functionality** to segment and transmit files to ground.
The subtopology shall provide on-board file management functionality (e.g., list, remove, hash, mkdir).
The subtopology shall provide **parameter management** via the filesystem.
The subtopology shall support **configurable instance properties** (IDs, queue sizes, stack sizes, priorities, CPU affinities).
The subtopology shall expose **rate-group connection points** for any rate-drive components it contains.
